hooks.text: 数织谜题随深入从5×5扩张至20×20，深度同时提高风险与奖励
hooks.excerpt: Increasing difficulty The deeper you go into the dungeon, the more complex the puzzles become. Solve procedurally generated nonograms of various grid sizes from 5x5 to 20x20. Risk grows with depth, but so do the rewards.
